Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Jr. Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jr. Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37000 Per Month plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Jr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a 1st class MTech with NET/GATE/PhD in Biomass processing/ Pulp and Paper Technology/ Pulp Technology process engineering.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Jr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for more information?
faq.answer: The official website for more information is http://ird.iitd.ac.in.
